title: Aspect, Grangier, and Roger violated a Bell inequality
summary: Their 1982 Physical Review Letters paper reports a Bell-inequality violation with photon pairs.
body: Alain Aspect, Philippe Grangier, and Gérard Roger published "Experimental Realization of Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen-Bohm Gedankenexperiment: A New Violation of Bell's Inequalities" in 1982. The paper reports a laboratory violation of a Bell inequality. That is evidence against local hidden-variable models of the kind Bell defined. It is not, by itself, a demonstration that people can send messages faster than light. The no-signaling reading is the standard textbook caution and is easy to lose in the phrase "instantly affects."
